findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "visa-requirements" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: post_v2_visa_check · Public sink: post_v2_passport_rank_custom, post_v2_visa_map, post_v2_visa_mapall, post_v2_visa_check, post, post_map.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: post_v2_visa_check · Public sink: post_v2_passport_rank_custom, post_v2_visa_map, post_v2_visa_mapall, post_v2_visa_check, post, post_map

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
